proposals.evidence: DEDR 2594 attests Tamil and Malayalam cinna small, Kodagu ciṇṇi, Telugu cinna, Kolami sinnam/cinni and Parji cin. These selected southern survey forms fit the cinna family; Gondi and Kurux lookalikes require separate contact evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
